description: BFM Benchmark evaluates humanoid whole-body motion-tracking policies under a unified physics protocol (Protocol v2). Policies run in isolated worker processes, PD torques are recomputed and saturated at every physics step, and full traces are independently verified.
scoring_summary: The primary ranking metric is full-motion MPBPE with pelvis XY translation alignment only (mm, lower is better), retaining yaw and height errors. Failure rules follow SuperMimic Appendix A: root height difference > 0.25 m or projected unit-gravity Z difference > 0.8 (end-effector deviation is not a failure condition).

alignment_modes.label: XY Aligned (Primary)
alignment_modes.transform: Center actual and reference root XY translation per frame
alignment_modes.retained: Yaw heading, height, tilt, and articulated body pose

alignment_modes.label: XY + Yaw Aligned
alignment_modes.transform: Center root XY and align closest world-Z heading rotation
alignment_modes.retained: Height, tilt, and articulated pose (degenerate frames reported via yaw_alignment_degenerate_fraction)

alignment_modes.label: World Frame (Unaligned)
alignment_modes.retained: Global trajectory drift and full-body pose
